current.summary: 适配 ChatGPT 新版页面：深色模式盖住新版漏出的纯黑块，文件夹不再失踪；商店版预计 7 月 18 日过审。
current.bodyMarkdown:
## 中文 — 常用功能

- **时间线 (Timeline)**：右侧紫色小豆豆，每条对话一个，鼠标悬浮看预览、点击跳转。
- **图钉 (Pins)**：长回答里点段落可以钉住，小豆豆上会显示钉子标记，上下箭头在同一段对话内的钉子之间切换。
- **收藏 / 收藏夹**：preview row 上点星标即可收藏；点悬浮面板底栏「Favorites」打开收藏夹，**跨对话**的收藏也能看。
- **导出对话**：右上角 Share 旁边的 ⬇ 按钮点开是个小菜单——「整个导出」一键导出当前对话，或「选择导出」勾选要的消息只导出那几条；格式在扩展弹窗「对话导出」一栏切换（标准 / 简化 Markdown、标准 / 简化 JSON、HTML）。
- **临时反悔（Undo temp）**：临时对话右上角的反悔按钮，一键把当前临时对话作为前情提要带到一段全新的正式对话里——不丢上下文。
- **Prompt 管理器**：右下角悬浮球，存提示词、tag、搜索、点一下复制或插入到输入框。
- **公式点击复制**：渲染好的公式直接点就复制 LaTeX；扩展弹窗里可切 LaTeX / MathML / 无美元符号 / Notion ($$) 几种格式。
- **自动隐藏官方右侧导航**：开着 Voyager 时间线时，自动把 ChatGPT 自带那条简陋的右侧 prompt 导航条藏掉，右边清爽不打架；关掉时间线它自己回来。
- **更温和的深色模式**：深色模式下把 ChatGPT 那刺眼的纯黑背景换成柔和的深灰（含 Codex 页面、底部输入框淡出带、代码块标题栏），扩展弹窗「外观」一栏开关，只在深色模式生效，默认关。
- **布局调整**：扩展弹窗里有滑块改聊天宽度、聊天字号、代码块字号、输入框宽度、侧边栏宽度。

## ✨ 1.7.3 新增

- **适配 ChatGPT 新版页面**：ChatGPT 这次大改版（Chat / Work 分屏，新增文件库、已安排、插件等页面）对插件造成了几处不适配，已全部修好——「更温和的深色模式」盖住了新版漏出的刺眼纯黑块（Work 页建议列表、文件库筛选条、Codex 各页面等）；文件夹面板也不会再因为进过「文件库」页而消失。
- **📦 版本说明**：已在 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases) 发布（可直接下载安装），Chrome / Edge 商店版**预计 7 月 18 日审核通过**——想现在就用，去 GitHub 装最新的即可。

## 反馈

有需求 / 发现 bug 欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues) 提一下。

---

## English — common features

- **Timeline** — Purple dots on the right side, one per turn. Hover to preview, click to jump.
- **Pins** — Pin specific paragraphs inside long answers; the dot shows a pin marker, up/down arrows cycle pins within the same turn.
- **Favorites** — Star any preview row; open the favorites panel from the floating panel's footer "Favorites" button — also works across conversations.
- **Conversation export** — The ⬇ button next to Share opens a small menu: **Entire conversation** (one-click) or **Select & export** (tick messages, download only those). Pick a format in the popup's "Conversation export" section (standard / simplified Markdown, standard / simplified JSON, or HTML).
- **Undo temp** — A regret button in the top-right of every temporary chat. One click captures the whole temp conversation and hands it off to a fresh persistent chat — context preserved.
- **Prompt Manager** — Floating ball bottom-right. Stores prompts with tags + search; click to copy or insert.
- **Formula click-to-copy** — Click any rendered formula to copy its LaTeX. Format (LaTeX / MathML / no-dollar / Notion) configurable in the popup.
- **Auto-hide ChatGPT's native right-edge nav** — while Voyager's Timeline is on, the clunky native prompt-nav dashes are hidden automatically; turn the Timeline off and they come back.
- **Gentler dark mode** — swaps ChatGPT's harsh pure-black dark theme for soft dark grays (including Codex pages, the fade band above the composer and code-block headers). Toggle under *Appearance* in the popup; dark mode only, off by default.
- **Layout sliders** — Chat width, chat font size, code block font size, composer width, sidebar width — all in the extension popup.

## ✨ What's new in 1.7.3

- **Adapted to ChatGPT's redesign** — ChatGPT's big update (the Chat / Work split, plus the new Library / Scheduled / Apps pages) broke a few things; all fixed: gentle dark mode now covers the harsh pure-black patches the redesign introduced (the Work-tab suggestion list, the library filter bar, Codex pages), and the folder panel no longer vanishes after visiting the Library page.
- **📦 Release note** — ships on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases) first; the Chrome / Edge store build **should be approved by July 18** — install from GitHub if you want it now.

## Feedback

Drop requests / bugs at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues).
